content: {"episode_id":"ep-05100","cpt":"93226","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93226 was ordered for a 48-hour Holter monitor providing continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic recording in a patient with unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91) and cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9). The patient reports persistent episodes of palpitations (R00.2) that interfere with daily activities. The monitoring was ordered to characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, as documented in the clinical indication note submitted with this appeal. We request reconsideration of the PR-204 denial in light of this documented clinical indication."}
